question: Which family representation must the Gate-B mediator carry once the three-family version of Theta_1 is written explicitly?
verdict_scope: Three-family extensions written on the pair labels S^2(3); V1 = family-decoupled (one Theta_1 copy per family) is the extension used by the Gate-B design; representation level only (no spectra).
mathematical_verdict: V1_SYMMETRY_Z4^3xS3_AND_A4_MONOMIAL; V1_UNIQUE_DELTA_N4_TENSOR_OF_Z4^3xS3; A4_DIAG_PAIRS_1+1'+1'', OFF_DIAG_3; MEDIATOR_V1 = (10, 3_SIGNED_PERM) DEGENERATE_UNMIXED = 1+1'+1'' UNDER A4; A4_VECTOR_TRIPLET_GIVES_INTERFAMILY_V3; TRANSPORT_RESPECTS_V1_ONLY_IN_A4_MONOMIAL_BASIS
summary_de: Der Mediator muss kein Familiensingulett sein. Fuer die familien-entkoppelte Drei-Familien-Version V1 = sum_f O_{A,ff}^2 (Symmetrie Z4^3 x S3, einzige Delta-N=4-Familienstruktur dieser Symmetrie) ist der benoetigte Mediator ein reeller Z4-ungerader Spin(10)-Vektor pro Familie, entartet und ungemischt: (10, 3_signed-perm), unter A4 = 1 + 1' + 1''. Ein A4-Vektortriplett (10, 3) erzeugt dagegen die Zwischenfamilien-Paarung V3, nicht V1. Der v117-Transport respektiert V1 nur in der A4-monomialen Familienbasis. Quellenbezug (nur Darstellungen): [J(16,4) J(16,4)] enthaelt S^2(3) = 1+1'+1''+3, also familienweise Komposita der leichten Familien; die weggelassene Linie wird nicht gebraucht.
kills: (10,1) family-singlet as a necessary mediator requirement.
An A4-vector triplet mediator as the origin of the per-family vertex V1 (it gives interfamily pairing V3).
resolved: R_Phi for V1: (10, 3_signed-perm) of Z4^3 x| S3, degenerate and unmixed, = 1 + 1' + 1'' under A4.
Family-basis condition: V1 in the A4-monomial basis of the transport.
